column4: Implement the Step 1 bidder's per-request tmax minus measured-RTT deadline contract identified by the completed audit; add a deterministic regression fixture and receipt. Acceptance: the receiver reads each request tmax, computes a non-negative remaining budget from measured RTT, refuses expired work, preserves the privacy/no-body-log gates, and the focused test plus existing offline self-test pass with output and hashes recorded under ~/.mesh/evidence/artifacts; no external probes, device data, publication, or irreversible action.
